findings.title: Lock creation follows unchecked child/ancestor symlinks and can create or lock files outside the candidate namespace.
findings.evidence: Confirmed in /tmp without hostile concurrent replacement. A dangling role/write.lock symlink caused write_role to create the external target and return successfully with complete.json present. A features ancestor symlink caused synthetic-permit extract to create the external source_best_M/admission/run/extract.lock directory chain before later raising canonical path escape.
findings.actual_effect: Existing static symlinks bypass the namespace boundary for filesystem creation and flock acquisition. Pointing at another owner lock could also redirect exclusion; no real owner lock was touched in this review.
findings.recommendation: Validate the complete lock path and ancestors before any mkdir/open. Use root-relative directory handles with O_DIRECTORY/O_NOFOLLOW and O_NOFOLLOW on a validated regular lock fd, then flock that fd. Reject aliasing/shared lock inodes as required. Keep original accepted trainer unchanged; supply the safe wrapper only for M.
findings.regression_expectation: Child lock symlink and ancestor symlink must reject before any external file/directory is created or locked; valid duplicate writers must still exclude and release correctly.

findings.title: Cached manifest symlink is followed and accepted by both verification and completed resume.
findings.evidence: After a successful synthetic cache, manifest.parquet was changed to a symlink pointing to an identical small synthetic Parquet outside the artifact namespace. verify_role and completed write_role resume both returned successfully, with the symlink retained.
findings.actual_effect: Role-level canonical checks do not validate this leaf. Hash equality proves content but does not establish the required regular canonical cache artifact or storage ownership. Other tested array/identity/complete/chunk-marker symlinks reject; this manifest is an uncovered exception.
findings.recommendation: Inventory and validate every registered child, including manifest.parquet, as a nonsymlink regular artifact before hashing/reading/resume or copying. Preserve rejected evidence; do not overwrite or repair the symlink.
findings.regression_expectation: Same-byte external manifest symlink, dangling manifest symlink and wrong child types reject before completion/resume; external data remain unchanged.

findings.title: Accepted cache inventory/metadata are not constrained by the overhead assumptions of the17.149GiB feature-only bound.
findings.evidence: A complete synthetic cache with an extra2MiB unregistered field in complete.json was accepted by verify_role and completed resume. The role consumed2,153,530 logical bytes versus1,111,619 bytes from the report same per-role formula. _json allows32MiB per file; no cumulative1MiB metadata/provenance quota or exact completion key set is enforced. An out-of-range chunk_999999.npy orphan is also ignored by verify_role and retained.
findings.actual_effect: Nominal registered FP32 payload arithmetic remains correct, but a successful verified candidate directory can exceed the report envelope. Ignored orphans, retained temporary evidence and repeated attempt/admission namespaces must not receive automatic capacity credit or be silently excluded from an actual physical/high-water budget.
findings.recommendation: Enforce exact registered schemas and a cumulative per-role metadata/provenance allowance matching the bound. Inventory permitted filenames and chunk ranges; validate all NPY headers, including in-range orphans, before load. Preserve/refuse unknown, out-of-range or residual temporary evidence until separately accounted. Keep atomic temporary peak and failed evidence in a separate fresh joint-capacity budget; never delete evidence merely to fit the nominal successful-cache envelope.
findings.regression_expectation: Oversized/unknown completion fields, cumulative metadata excess, out-of-range orphan and retained temporary files cannot produce an in-envelope successful cache. Valid same-input partial recovery remains append-only and within registered inventory.
